answer: Like dawn light through a prism, a reputation system splits one identity into verifiable facets: each agent posts a refundable stake that unlocks slowly over a long horizon, and earns trust only through attested work with real counterparties. A sybil attacker must fund a separate stake per fake identity and wait out the same slow unlock, so the cost of a hundred fake agents is a hundred stakes locked for months, while an honest agent pays once and reuses its reputation forever.
